text: {"lessons":["I shouldn't sell a stock just because it's above my average cost; a small gain or a large gain alone doesn't tell me whether to hold it.","I should judge each position by its prospects and role in my overall portfolio, not treat it as a separate account or avoid admitting a losing purchase was a mistake.","Recent price moves haven't reliably predicted what comes next, so I should avoid trading just to react to short-term fluctuations."]}
